about_the_game:
Stick Figure Combat is an action-packed, fast-paced battle experience where you fight hordes of relentless grey enemies to achieve the highest score possible. Test your survival skills as you face off against endless waves of foes, each more challenging than the last. Hone your abilities, unlock new weapons, and fight for dominance in an ever-intensifying combat arena.

Feeling creative? Build and share your own custom maps to challenge your friends or the community! Whether you’re aiming to survive as long as possible or simply having fun with your own designs, the choice is yours.

Key Features:

  • Endless Waves of Combat: Fight through increasingly difficult enemies in a test of skill and endurance.

  • Custom Map Creation: Design your own unique battlefields and share them with the community.

  • Unlockable Weapons & Upgrades: Discover powerful tools to help you survive longer and defeat tougher enemies.

  • Competitive Leaderboards: See how you rank against other players and strive to reach the top of the leaderboard.

Survive. Fight. Create. The battle never ends in Stick Figure Combat!

This version adds more excitement, clarity, and a focus on the game’s key features, helping it stand out more to potential players on Steam!

Recommended:
